subject: general
question: Which of the following options is related to the 124th Constitutional Amendment Bill?

options.text: Right to free and compulsory education up to the age of fourteen years
10% reservation for economically weaker sections of general category

solution:
The correct answer is __**10% reservation for economically weaker sections of general category**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **The 124th Constitutional Amendment Bill** pertains to providing a **10% reservation for economically weaker sections (EWS) of the general category**.
 
• This amendment was aimed at addressing economic inequalities by extending reservation benefits to economically disadvantaged individuals who do not belong to any other reserved category.
 
• The bill was passed by both houses of Parliament in January 2019 and subsequently received the President's assent.
 
• This reservation is in addition to the existing reservations provided to Scheduled Castes, Scheduled Tribes, and Other Backward Classes.
 
• The criteria for eligibility under this reservation include factors such as household income, land ownership, and other economic indicators.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The 124th Constitutional Amendment led to the introduction of **Articles 15(6) and 16(6)** in the Constitution of India.
 
• **Article 15(6)** allows for the reservation of seats in educational institutions, while **Article 16(6)** allows for reservation in government jobs for EWS.
 
• This amendment was a significant step towards promoting social justice and inclusivity for economically weaker sections of society.
 
• The reservation is applicable to both central and state government institutions, as well as private educational institutions, except minority educational institutions.
 
• The amendment has been subject to various debates and legal challenges, but it reflects the government's commitment to addressing economic disparities.
